title: Finite normalization of the given tower left compositor
statement: Fix distinct primes p and ell, a field k of characteristic p, a finite extension E of Q_ell, separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y,Z, and smooth k-morphisms f:X->Y and g:Y->Z of pure relative dimensions d,e. Let cf,cg,ch be compactifications of f,g,fg. Use the actual section-normalized coefficient-tower coordinates b,o,q, finite coordinates z, uniform ctf preservation hP, and a supplied Calculus cal of [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces]. For each n let vf_n,vg_n,vh_n be Evaluation structures for these compactifications, normalized by their prescribed Fcomparison words. Let A_n be a FiniteAdjointCompositorDatum of [lem-sp-finite-adjoint-compositor-transposes] for the coefficient ring R_n=O_E/ell^(n+1), whose left compositor alpha_n has its prescribed etale normalization. For every n and uniform ctf tower M on X, evaluation of the actual arrow cal.composition.composition(f,g,cf,cg,ch) followed by vh_n(M) equals vg_n(F_f M), followed by F_g,n(vf_n(M)), followed by alpha_n(M_n). No right compositor, reduction identity or normalization preservation is asserted here.

proof.text: The supplied cal.coherence.composition_finite is the evaluation equation for the actual tower compositor in the fixed module coordinates. Every Evaluation comparison equals the same realization-counit/Fcomparison word by its normalization field. Replace cal.finite.evaluation by vf,vg,vh in that equation.

By cal.finite.finite_origin the fixed-coordinate evaluation M_n has a bounded-below etale witness. The intrinsic coordinate equivalence transports this witness to one for the intrinsic module object M_n. Since M is uniform ctf, M_n is finite ctf, so the normalization field of A_n applies to that witness. It writes alpha_n as the etale compositor transported through finiteAdjointSiteSupportIso. Finite compact-site coherence identifies the same transported etale word with finiteCanonicalComposition for the chosen compactifications; its common-refinement equations handle cf,cg,ch.

Naturality transports the witness equation to M_n. Substitute it into the first equation and cancel the fully faithful intrinsic-to-fixed derived equivalence. This gives exactly the displayed intrinsic evaluation identity; no faithfulness of the tower evaluation functor is used.

theorem towerCompositorFiniteEvaluation
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (_hpl : p ≠ l) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (d e : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension e g]
    (z : SpTowerCalculus.FiniteCoordinates l E)
    (hP : SpTowerCalculus.Preservation l E k b o q)
    (cal : SpTowerCalculus.Calculus l E k b o q z hP)
    (vf : ∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerCalculus.Evaluation l E b o q cf n)
    (vg : ∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerCalculus.Evaluation l E b o q cg n)
    (vh : ∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerCalculus.Evaluation l E b o q ch n)
    (A : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteAdjointCompositorDatum (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) cf cg ch)
    (n : ℕ) (M : SpTowerCalculus.C l E b q X) :
    (spDerivedCoefficientEvaluation l E Z (q.abelian Z) n).map
        ((cal.composition.composition f g (f ≫ g) rfl cf cg ch).hom.app M) ≫
      (vh n).comparison.hom.app M.obj =
    (vg n).comparison.hom.app ((SpTowerCalculus.F l E b o q cf).obj M.obj) ≫
      (reductionCompactSupport (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) cg.i cg.g).map
        ((vf n).comparison.hom.app M.obj) ≫
      ((A n).alpha.hom.app ((SpTowerGluing.level l E b q X n).obj M)).hom
